burkan.description: Burkan keeps your Galaxy S23 on Android's Vulkan renderer, which many owners say makes the phone smoother, cooler and easier on the battery. Android resets it to OpenGL on every reboot, and normally the only fix is plugging into a computer each time. Burkan pairs once with the phone's own Wireless Debugging, or uses Shizuku. After each restart it turns Vulkan back on by itself as soon as the phone is on Wi-Fi, and it checks that the change took. System UI restarts the next time you lock the phone, so nothing happens in front of you. You can also apply Vulkan by hand, restart apps that are still on OpenGL, keep chosen apps from ever being restarted, or go back to OpenGL at any time. No root, no computer, no internet.
